notes: No wild-type BW25113 sample: the two parent strains pykF(C8Y) and rpoB(T1037P) (fast-growing M9-glucose adapted mutants) are the strains the rifampicin-resistant derivatives are compared against, labelled genotype_class reference and, in M9G without rifampicin, is_control true; derived strains are point_mutation with both genes. Rifampicin present from dilution (adapted); resistant strains keep growing, transcription_arrested false. rRNA removal not stated (TruSeq stranded RNA kit). Oxygen/shaking not stated.
